findings.title: Use const for variables that are never reassigned
findings.message: Replace `var` with `const` for variables that are never reassigned. Variables like `jwt`, `config`, `token`, `decoded`, `userId`, `role`, and `message` are not reassigned after initialization, so they should use `const` instead. `const` signals intent and prevents accidental reassignment.

findings.title: Do not leave console.log in production code
findings.message: Remove `console.warn` and `console.error` calls from production code. Use the project's logger instead to maintain consistent logging and avoid leaking sensitive information in production logs.

findings.title: All env access goes through ConfigService
findings.message: Replace direct `process.env.JWT_SECRET` access with a typed property from ConfigService. ConfigService should be injected and validate the secret at construction time, not at runtime. Add a `jwtSecret` property to ConfigService and inject it into this middleware.
